thread:
Ashley K.: heads-up — after the roles refactor a couple of internal dashboards now show rows from other customers. I spotted PII in query results. tagging @Chandra and @Benj.
Benj: omg. which dashboard? can you paste the query or a redacted screenshot?
Ashley K.: internal-ops/dashboard-app, top-level logs panel. redacted snippet: `SELECT * FROM ops_logs WHERE tenant_id = 'tenant-123' LIMIT 5;` — but results included tenant-456 data.
Chandra: that sounds like a policy scope bleed. Did the refactor change service-account bindings or default namespace mapping?
Ashley K.: we changed the default viewer role merging rule last night (PR 4321). I suspect the merger accidentally granted read to `ops_internal_viewer` across tenant prefixes.
Benj: can we revoke that role quickly? I can push a deny-rule if needed.
sec-bot: ALERT: Data-access-anomaly detected for dashboard internal-ops/dashboard-app at 2026-03-20T02:27:14Z. Count( cross-tenant rows ) = 12.
Chandra: urgent plan: 1) revoke `ops_internal_viewer` on dashboard-app 2) rotate the SA token used by dashboard runner 3) run a quick audit for exposed rows 4) temp keep dashboard read-only.
Ashley K.: doing step 1 now: `rbacctl revoke binding --role ops_internal_viewer --resource dashboard:internal-ops/dashboard-app`
deploy-bot: deploy started for revoke at 2026-03-20T02:31:05Z (deploy id dpl-7812).
Benj: after revoke, run `SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ops_logs WHERE tenant_id != 'tenant-123' AND dashboard='internal-ops/dashboard-app';` — Ellis has a script to pull matches, I can run it with you.
Ashley K.: revoke finished. dashboard UI shows limited results now.
Chandra: good. next rotate SA token: `kms wrap-rotate --key projects/redwood/locations/global/keyR --identity dashboard-runner-sa` — Benj, can you coordinate?
Benj: on it. rotating token and will update runner env vars. I'll also add a deny policy blocking `list` and `read` across tenant prefixes for that resource until root cause fixed.
sec-bot: NOTE: New deny policy queued. Manual approval required.
Ashley K.: audit run: found 14 distinct cross-tenant rows written in last 12h. I'll start a redaction/export to secure bucket.
Chandra: start forensic capture: save query logs + request headers. Check if KV cache might have been shared between tenant contexts (possible in the runtime merge).
Benj: I found the refactor change: defaultContextResolver now falls back to global when tenant header missing. Fix: make it error instead of fallback. PR ready, will attach test that asserts tenant isolation.
Ashley K.: temporary mitigation steps done. Dashboard set to read-only, SA rotated, revoke applied, export in progress.
Chandra: postmortem checklist: 1) roll forward fix + tests 2) run org-wide audit for refactor PRs touching context resolver 3) retention policy for exported data 4) notify compliance + affected customers (legal to confirm).
Benj: PR opened and CI green. planning to roll in 30m with canary.
deploy-bot: rolling canary deploy for PR 4387 (context-resolver-fix) to 5% pods.
sec-bot: REMINDER: Create incident ticket and mark sev2.
Ashley K.: filing incident ticket now and pinging legal. thanks everyone. :+1:
Chandra: good catch Ashley. keep thread updated with export link and customer notif text.
Ashley K.: will do — export link: s3://redwood-sec-exports/2250001234/export-1.csv (access controlled). Customer notif draft saved in /docs/incidents/2250001234-draft.md
Benj: after rollout I'll run a full audit for the last 48h and share findings.
Chandra: once we confirm no further leakage, let's schedule a short postmortem tomorrow.
Ashley K.: closing loop here as initial remediation complete. continuing monitoring.
